+        state = {

+            "status": self.r.status(),
+            "tcp_pose": now[8:15].tolist(),
+            "gripper_opening_m": float(now[24]),
+            "gripper_cmd": float(now[15]),
+        }
+        with open(os.path.join(OUT, f"{label}_state.json"), "w") as f:
+            json.dump(state, f, indent=2)
+        print(json.dumps(state), flush=True)
+        return obs
+
+    def move(self, xyz, gripper=None, label="move"):
+        self.n += 1
+        current = self.r.get_obs(video="none").meta["proprio"]["now"]
+        g = float(current[15] > 0.5) if gripper is None else float(gripper)
+        pose = np.r_[np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float), DOWN, g].astype(np.float32)
+        print(f"MOVE {self.n} {label}: {pose.tolist()}", flush=True)
+        res = self.r.submit("ee_pose", pose, video="none", note=label)
+        print("PLAN", json.dumps(res.meta.get("plan")), "DONE", res.done, flush=True)
+        if res.done:
+            self.save_state(label + "_done", res)
+            return res
+        return self.save_state(label, res)
+
+    def wait(self, seconds, label):
+        obs = self.r.get_obs(seconds=seconds, video="none")
+        return self.save_state(label, obs)
+
+    def pickup(self, name, xy, contact_z, high_z=0.30):
+        self.move([xy[0], xy[1], high_z], 0, name + "_pregrasp")
+        self.move([xy[0], xy[1], contact_z], 0, name + "_grasp_open")
